countries.name: United States
countries.photoExplanation: Photos are discouraged in the US due to EEOC anti-discrimination regulations.
countries.atsGuidance: High ATS priority. Single-column layouts ensure 100% parse rates.

countries.name: Canada
countries.photoExplanation: Photos are typically omitted in Canada to comply with human rights standards.
countries.atsGuidance: Clean bullet hierarchy is paramount for Taleo, Workday, and BambooHR.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.photoExplanation: UK recruiters discourage photos under UK Equality Act 2010 regulations.

countries.name: Germany / DACH
countries.photoExplanation: A professional headshot (Bewerbungsfoto) is traditional in Germany.
countries.atsGuidance: Clear table-like tabular structure with distinct date columns.

countries.name: European Union / Europass
countries.photoExplanation: Photos are accepted across continental Europe, though optional.
countries.atsGuidance: Recognized by EU-wide job portals including EURES.

countries.name: Australia
countries.photoExplanation: Australian employers prefer no photo to align with fair work practices.
countries.atsGuidance: Strong ATS emphasis on explicit skill keywords mapped directly to the PD.

countries.name: UAE & Gulf Region
countries.photoExplanation: A crisp professional headshot in business attire is customary in the Gulf.
countries.atsGuidance: Leading GCC enterprises use Taleo, SAP SuccessFactors, and Bayt.

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.photoExplanation: A formal passport-size photo is standard convention for corporate & bank CVs.
countries.atsGuidance: Standard headings: Career Objective, Experience, Education, Referees.

countries.name: Japan
countries.photoExplanation: A formal 30mm x 40mm studio photo (スーツ着用 証明写真) is strictly required.
countries.atsGuidance: Japanese employers parse structured chronological tables and Furigana headers.

templates.name: JIS Standard Rirekisho (履歴書)
templates.description: Official Japanese standard JIS Rirekisho with Furigana (ふりがな), 30x40mm photo frame, chronological Education & Work grid ending with 以上, licenses, and Self-PR.

templates.name: Japanese Shokumu Keirekisho (職務経歴書)
templates.description: Detailed Japanese career progression document detailing project responsibilities, team sizes, and technical stack.

templates.name: Clean ATS Standard
templates.description: High-parse single column layout optimized for Greenhouse, Workday, and Taleo.

templates.name: Modern Executive
templates.description: Clean modern layout with subtle accents and strong typography.

templates.name: European Academic & Classic
templates.description: Structured serif layout with distinct date columns, ideal for German Lebenslauf and European institutions.

templates.name: Nordic Minimalist
templates.description: Crisp whitespace and understated typographic scale.

templates.name: Gulf & Global Executive
templates.description: Executive banner with corporate badges, ideal for leadership profiles in UAE and multinational roles.

templates.name: Designer & Portfolio
templates.description: Dynamic two-column sidebar layout for creative agencies and tech startups.

templates.name: Systems Engineer Tech
templates.description: Data-dense grid highlighting core tech stacks, cloud certifications, and project links.

templates.name: Bangladesh Corporate & Bank Biodata
templates.description: Comprehensive biodata layout including permanent address, father/mother name, religion, blood group, and references.
